description.value: Taste of Thai is an established Vancouver Thai restaurant that has been serving authentic dishes since 1986, with chefs using special herbs and spices flown in fresh from Thailand. The menu spans curries, stir-fries, and rice dishes prepared without MSG, promising bold flavours and aromatic complexity. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with online ordering for takeout on West Broadway, a major cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; rack (5 spaces) at 45m; rack (5 spaces) at 52m; stands (4 spaces) at 70m; rack (5 spaces) at 87m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and confirms an active sit-down Thai restaurant at 3629 West Broadway, Vancouver, operating since 1986. Phone numbers (604-568-8668 / 604-566-9118) and address are corroborated by the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; the 'ORDER NOW' shopping cart confirms takeout ordering is available.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; two numbers found on website (604-568-8668 and 604-566-9118) — primary added from website source.
Website footer lists postal code 'V3W 0W9', which is a Surrey postal code, not consistent with a West Broadway, Vancouver address (expected V6R area). May be a site-builder placeholder error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, long-running restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor, but no required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available sources. A brief on-site or phone verification would resolve all three.
enrichment_extras.notes: Secondary phone number from website: 604-566-9118. Catering inquiries can also be directed to thaifoodwimaan@gmail.com per the website.
